facts.fact: ANIP's Herbert Assogba says the Guichet Unique pilot in ten public health facilities (from 20 August 2025) lets a birth be declared and registered in the maternity, with the NPI generated within 72 hours and the data feeding the RNPP; over 13,000 of 17,071 children declared were registered.
